series_key: creating an mql5-telegram integrated expert advisor
mechanism: BotFather token + chat ID + WebRequest POST to api.telegram.org/sendMessage; allow-URL allowlist; emoji message templates for EA init/balance/orders—messaging plumbing only.
data_needed: Telegram bot token; chat/group ID; WebRequest allowlist for https://api.telegram.org
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart _Symbol on attach; no market sensing TF.
why_new_for_mis: Part 1 is Telegram bot setup and HTTP messaging tutorial with no regime/vol/liquidity sensor.
quote: By the end of Part 1, we will possess a basic but functional system capable of sending text messages from our EA to Telegram.

series_key: creating an mql5-telegram integrated expert advisor
mechanism: On new bar (iBars gate): CopyBuffer EMA(20,PRICE_CLOSE) and SMA(50,PRICE_CLOSE); bullish flip when fastMA[1]>slowMA[1] && fastMA[2]<=slowMA[2]; bearish flip when fastMA[1]<slowMA[1] && fastMA[2]>=slowMA[2]; close opposite magic positions then open market trade and Telegram-notify.
data_needed: iMA handles MODE_EMA 20 and MODE_SMA 50 on close; 3-bar buffers as series; Ask/Bid; magic filter.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Attached _Symbol/_Period; live test on M1 with MA periods 5 and 10 for faster flips.
why_new_for_mis: Discrete completed-bar EMA/SMA state-cross as a binary regime-change event stream (not continuous MA level)—MIS can ingest flip timestamps as change sensors across any symbol/TF.
quote: if the most recent fast-moving average (fastMA1) is greater than the corresponding slow-moving average (slowMA1), and the previous fast-moving average (fastMA2) was less than or equal to the previous slow-moving average (slowMA2), then we're looking at a bullish crossover

series_key: creating an mql5-telegram integrated expert advisor
mechanism: OnInit: iOpen/iClose of bar index 1; isBuySignal if open<close (bull candle), else sell; open 0.01 lot with ±1000*_Point SL/TP and encode position metadata to Telegram.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Attached chart symbol and period at EA load.
why_new_for_mis: Single completed-candle direction as a coarse instantaneous regime label at session start—MIS can use last-bar polarity as a cheap binary state feature.
quote: bool isBuySignal = Price_Open < Price_Close; bool isSellSignal = Price_Open >= Price_Close;

series_key: creating an mql5-telegram integrated expert advisor
mechanism: ChartScreenShot → binary FileReadArray → CryptEncode BASE64 → MD5 boundary → multipart/form-data WebRequest sendPhoto with caption (symbol/TF/time); optional ChartOpen + SERIES_SYNCHRONIZED wait—delivery/encoding tutorial.
data_needed: Chart screenshot JPG/PNG; Telegram sendPhoto endpoint; chat_id.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol/_Period of opened or current chart; 1366×768 capture.
why_new_for_mis: Part 3 is image encode/transmit plumbing for alerts, not a market regime or volatility sensor.
quote: Sending images over the Internet and, particularly, integrating with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) or messaging platforms requires the image data first to be encoded

mechanism: Uppercase-split Telegram multiline command; extract INDICATOR TYPE/SYMBOL/TIMEFRAME/PERIOD/SHIFT/METHOD/APPLIED PRICE; map to ENUM_TIMEFRAMES/ENUM_MA_METHOD/ENUM_APPLIED_PRICE; iMA handle + ChartOpen + ChartIndicatorAdd—remote chart tooling.
data_needed: Structured Telegram text lines; SymbolsTotal/SymbolName; iMA parameters.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: User-specified symbols (e.g. XAUUSDm) and TFs M1–MN1 from Telegram command.

quote: We will create a system where the Expert Advisor captures user-defined indicator parameters via Telegram, parses the data, and applies the specified indicators to trading charts in real-time.

mechanism: Supertrend always bullish (line below price) or bearish (line above). Bullish signal only when most recently completed candle closes above Supertrend upper band (bear→bull flip); bearish when it closes below lower band (bull→bear flip). Evaluate only on completed candles—no partial-bar reads.
data_needed: Supertrend upper/lower bands from custom indicator; completed bar close; atrPeriod and atrMultiplier inputs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 backtest 2025-01-01..2025-12-31; EA timeframe input (default PERIOD_CURRENT); long-only test.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit binary trend-state machine with one event per flip—MIS regime-change stream tied to ATR-banded Supertrend rather than raw MA cross.
quote: A bullish signal occurs when the most recently completed candle closes above the Supertrend upper band.

mechanism: CopyBuffer bands 5 (upper) and 6 (lower) as series; bullish if lowerBandValues[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE && upperBandValues[2]!=EMPTY_VALUE (lower newly active, upper was active prior); bearish if upperBandValues[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE && lowerBandValues[2]!=EMPTY_VALUE—state inferred from which band is populated.
data_needed: supertrend.ex5 buffers 5/6; ≥3 recent values; EMPTY_VALUE checks.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Configured symbol/timeframe of EA; journal-validated alternating bull/bear prints on new bars.
why_new_for_mis: Regime label from buffer occupancy (which band is live) rather than price-vs-band arithmetic alone—MIS can treat EMPTY_VALUE switches as discrete state sensors.
quote: A bullish signal occurs when the lower band becomes active on the most recently completed bar while the upper band was active on the bar before it.

mechanism: SL_MODE_SUPERTREND_VOLATILITY (and SL_MODE_NONE sizing path): buy SL at NormalizeDouble(lowerBandValues[1]); sell SL at upperBandValues[1]—ATR-derived Supertrend band as dynamic protective level and risk-distance input.
data_needed: Prior-bar Supertrend band; Digits(); entry price for distance.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 test used swing-extreme SL; band-vol mode available as input; atrPeriod=10, atrMultiplier=1.5 defaults.
why_new_for_mis: Volatility sensor that reuses the same ATR-banded trail that defines trend state as the stop/risk distance—MIS can couple regime flips to vol-adaptive adverse excursion.
quote: The second model is volatility-based. In this case, the stop loss is placed at the Supertrend band value from the last completed candle, using the indicator itself as a dynamic protective level.

mechanism: iCustom Supertrend with atrPeriod (default 10) and atrMultiplier (default 1.5): smaller period → more reactive flips; larger multiplier → wider bands, fewer signals, longer trends—explicit vol-envelope knobs governing signal frequency.
data_needed: ATR lookback and multiplier passed into embedded supertrend.ex5 resource.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same as EA attach symbol/TF; parameters.set for reproducible tester runs.
why_new_for_mis: Parameterized ATR envelope as a tunable volatility-regime controller for trend-flip density—MIS can sweep multiplier/period as vol-sensitivity axes.
quote: A higher multiplier produces wider bands, fewer signals, and longer trends. A lower multiplier produces tighter bands and more frequent signals.

mechanism: CalculatePositionSizeByRisk: amountAtRisk=(riskPerTradePercent/100)*ACCOUNT_BALANCE; volume=amountAtRisk/(contractSize*stopDistance); NormalizeDouble(.,2)—stop distance (swing or Supertrend) becomes the vol proxy that scales lot size.
data_needed: Account balance; SYMBOL_TRADE_CONTRACT_SIZE; stopDistance from adaptive SL; riskPerTradePercent (test 1%).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 2025; MODE_AUTO lot sizing; 1% risk per trade.
why_new_for_mis: Turns chosen stop geometry into an online risk/volatility exposure sensor that auto-scales size—MIS can track implied vol-budget per signal.
quote: The EA uses this value, along with the stop-loss distance, to calculate position size. This ensures consistent risk exposure across different market conditions.

mechanism: IsNewBar compares iTime(symbol,tf,0) to lastBarOpenTime; only then UpdateSupertrendBandValues and evaluate bull/bear flips—one decision per completed bar, avoiding tick-path repaint.
data_needed: Bar open time series; lastBarOpenTime state; configured timeframe.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EA timeframe input independent of chart; H1 gold test.
why_new_for_mis: Change-event gate that forces MIS sensors to fire on confirmed bar boundaries—reduces false flip noise from intra-bar Supertrend wobble.
quote: Trading decisions are evaluated only when a new candle opens. This avoids repeated execution on every tick and ensures that signals are based on confirmed bar data.

mechanism: SL_MODE_SWING_EXTREME: buy SL=iLow(symbol,tf,1); sell SL=iHigh(symbol,tf,1)—prior completed candle extreme as structure-based protective level used in 2025 XAUUSD long-only test.
data_needed: Prior bar high/low on signal timeframe.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 2025; long-only; swing-extreme SL enabled in reported backtest.
why_new_for_mis: Local structure sensor for adverse-excursion bound at signal bar—MIS can pair Supertrend flips with last-bar range extremes as risk anchors.
quote: For long positions, the stop loss is placed at the low of the most recently completed candle. For short positions, it is placed at the candle's high.

mechanism: ENUM_TRADE_DIRECTION ONLY_LONG/ONLY_SHORT/TRADE_BOTH gates whether a detected Supertrend flip is allowed to open; opposing magic positions always closed on flip so exposure matches indicator state.
data_needed: direction input; PositionsTotal scan by magic; bull/bear signal flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1 long-only configuration in article test (ONLY_LONG).
why_new_for_mis: External directional-bias filter as a regime overlay on Supertrend flips—MIS can combine discretionary macro bias with automated state-change execution.
quote: The EA can be launched in long-only, short-only, or fully bidirectional mode. This allows discretionary bias to coexist with automation.
